mapper.sql: FROM trade_order_publication_issue pi INNER JOIN trade_order o ON o.id = pi.order_id AND o.deleted = FALSE LEFT JOIN product_sku sku ON sku.id = pi.sku_id AND sku.deleted = FALSE LEFT JOIN product_publication_sku_ext sku_ext ON sku_ext.sku_id = pi.sku_id AND sku_ext.deleted = FALSE

SELECT demand.warehouseId, demand.warehouseNameSnapshot, demand.windowId, demand.windowNameSnapshot, demand.offerId, demand.offerSkuId, demand.spuId, demand.skuId, demand.productNameSnapshot, demand.productSkuNameSnapshot, demand.isbn, demand.issueId, demand.issueNo, demand.issueName, demand.demandCount, COALESCE(balance.receivedCount, 0) AS receivedCount, COALESCE(balance.allocatedCount, 0) AS allocatedCount, GREATEST(COALESCE(balance.receivedCount, 0) - COALESCE(balance.allocatedCount, 0), 0) AS availableCount, GREATEST(demand.demandCount - GREATEST(COALESCE(balance.receivedCount, 0) - COALESCE(balance.allocatedCount, 0), 0), 0) AS shortageCount, GREATEST(demand.demandCount - GREATEST(COALESCE(balance.receivedCount, 0) - COALESCE(balance.allocatedCount, 0), 0), 0) AS suggestExpectedCount FROM ( SELECT pi.warehouse_id AS warehouseId, MAX(pi.warehouse_name_snapshot) AS warehouseNameSnapshot, pi.window_id AS windowId, MAX(pi.window_name_snapshot) AS windowNameSnapshot, pi.offer_id AS offerId, pi.offer_sku_id AS offerSkuId, MAX(pi.spu_id) AS spuId, pi.sku_id AS skuId, MAX(pi.product_name_snapshot) AS productNameSnapshot, MAX(sku.name) AS productSkuNameSnapshot, MAX(sku_ext.isbn) AS isbn, pi.issue_id AS issueId, pi.issue_no AS issueNo, MAX(pi.issue_name) AS issueName, COALESCE(SUM(pi.count), 0) AS demandCount
GROUP BY pi.warehouse_id, pi.window_id, pi.offer_id, pi.offer_sku_id, pi.sku_id, pi.issue_id, pi.issue_no ) demand LEFT JOIN ( SELECT warehouse_id, window_id, offer_id, offer_sku_id, sku_id, issue_id, issue_no, COALESCE(SUM(received_count), 0) AS receivedCount, COALESCE(SUM(allocated_count), 0) AS allocatedCount FROM repo_publication_receipt_item WHERE deleted = FALSE GROUP BY warehouse_id, window_id, offer_id, offer_sku_id, sku_id, issue_id, issue_no ) balance ON balance.warehouse_id = demand.warehouseId AND balance.window_id = demand.windowId AND balance.offer_id = demand.offerId AND balance.offer_sku_id = demand.offerSkuId AND balance.sku_id = demand.skuId AND (balance.issue_id = demand.issueId OR (balance.issue_id IS NULL AND demand.issueId IS NULL)) AND balance.issue_no = demand.issueNo
mapper.select: ORDER BY demand.windowId DESC, demand.issueNo ASC, demand.warehouseId ASC, demand.offerSkuId ASC, demand.skuId ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE repo_publication_receipt_item SET received_count = COALESCE(received_count, 0) + #{receivedCount}, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = FALSE
